_residence_doc: H4: a townsfolk house (GDD 4.6.1 Casa 3x3, 4.11.1). No interior: who goes in disappears at the door (location = the house) and comes out on the door tile. Owned by the household family that lives there (the map's population); characters.home points at it. upkeep 0 until the town economy asks for it [provisional].
